column_15: Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) and Central Micro-Nano Fabrication Facility (CMFF) - Indian Institute of Technology Palakkad
column_16: Startups with a valid KSUM UID can avail access to instrumentation services at subsidized rates. Eligible applicants are required to attach a copy of Kerala Startup Mission Unique ID certificate  along with the duly completed Job Requisition Form.
